claim_en: THE VOW CLASS. Gentiles vow; the class widened by 'all'; the nazirite out; no public compulsion; beasts whole and male, birds by a lesser bar.
middah: E1 ('any man of the house of Israel or of the strangers' — gentiles vow; the class widened by 'all'; the Nazirite out, E2, beside; no public compulsion; beasts whole and male, birds by a lesser bar; the received translation of 22:18-19 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE FIVE-COUNT. Consecrate, slaughter, throw, burn, part, receive; individual not public; the class sweep; fell and broke exempt; the blood-rush arms.
middah: plain (the five-count — consecrate, slaughter, throw, burn, part, receive; individual not public; the class sweep; fell and broke exempt; the blood-rush arms; the received translation of 22:21 the ink leg)

source: Sifra, Emor, Section 7 11-13 + Chapter 7 1-4 + Onkelos Lev 22:22
claim_en: THE BEAST'S ROW. Tail not rib; charutz; the two-way transfer; slaughter banned; worked-with permitted; fats, part, blood, and the dispatched goat.
middah: plain (the beast's row — tail not rib, the cut, the two-way transfer with the priest's list on the shared tokens, I2, beside; slaughter banned; worked-with permitted; the received translation of 22:22 the ink leg)

claim_en: SARUA AND KALUT. Uncloven hoof; for upkeep not the altar; no whole animal for upkeep; Onkelos's extra-and-lacking fork.
middah: plain (the stretched and the contracted defined — the uncloven hoof; for upkeep not the altar; no whole animal for upkeep; the received translation's extra-and-lacking fork, ink, beside)

claim_en: THE CASTRATION BAN. Three anatomies; receive-blood sixth; birds, abroad, humans by revocalization; no shekels from gentiles; females disputed.
middah: plain (the castration ban — three anatomies; receive-blood the sixth; birds and abroad; humans by revocalization, M-16, beside; no shekels from gentiles; females disputed; the received translation of 22:24-25 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE BIRTH LIST. Hybrid, look-alike, Caesarean, under-age, orphan; the tithe transfer; one hour with the mother; the eighth-day join.
middah: E2 ('an ox or sheep or goat when it is born' excludes the hybrid, the look-alike, the caesarean, the under-age, the orphan; the tithe transfer, I2, beside; one hour with the mother; the eighth-day join)

source: Sifra, Emor, Section 8 8-12 + Chapter 8 1-4 + Onkelos Lev 22:28
claim_en: IT AND ITS YOUNG. Not wild, not bird; the female alone — Onkelos feminizing the verse; it and its mother; the order cases at forty and eighty.
middah: E2 ('an ox or a sheep' — not wild, not bird; the female alone, the received translation feminizing the verse, ink, beside; it and its mother; the order cases at forty and eighty)

claim_en: THE FOUR PERIODS. The slaughter carve; the seller informs; the compelled butcher and the buyer's loss; day-after-night by the creation analogy.
middah: plain (the four periods — the slaughter carve, the seller informs, the compelled butcher and the buyer's loss; day-after-night by ben Zoma's 'one day' with Gen 1:5, I2, beside)

claim_en: THE REASSIGNMENT. The eating clause re-typed onto the slaughter; all one-day offerings.
middah: M-18 (the eating clause already known, freed and re-typed onto the slaughter — slaughter with intent to eat within the day; all one-day offerings; the received translation of 22:29 the ink leg)

claim_en: KEEP AND DO. Mishnah and deed; hand yourself over among the many; no conditional miracles; the Exodus on condition.
middah: M-09 ('keep' is Mishnah, 'do' is deed — the two verbs each assigned; hand yourself over among the many; no conditional miracles; the Exodus on condition; the received translation of 22:32 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE ACCEPTABLE ANIMAL ON ITS HAPAX AND ITS ONLY SEAT. The acceptance root at seven seats; the rite by call into the offering engine; one verb with three jobs by position; the four tokens of 22:22 assigned; Bekhorot 6 whole on the Sifra's members with three tokens shared with the priest's list; the corruption class in any amount; 'and from the day' a Tanakh hapax joined to the firstling (OWED to E1); 'on one day' the Torah's only seat, ben Zoma's day; the female by Onkelos's grammar; the second slaughter flogged. Filed F-229, auto-seated (sitting L5).
middah: ink (the acceptance root at seven seats; the four tokens of 22:22 assigned; 'and from the day' a Tanakh hapax; 'on one day' the Torah's only seat; Bekhorot 6 whole on the Sifra's members; the female by the received translation's grammar)
